notes: Total 12 (medium). The jupyter-server competency (C-9feab250, floor easy) is achieved by an executable config file the verifier genuinely launches with `jupyter server --config=...` and validates by actual loopback bind + tokenless HTTP 200, so the config must load, bind the env-sourced port, and switch auth off. reasoning_depth=2 comes from weighting the octet restriction into one self-contained strict IPv4 ERE (varial-digit 0..255 with no leading zeros, four groups, full-string anchors) so leading-zero and out-of-range octets are rejected; adversarial_inputs=2 and hidden_case_generalization=2 from the hidden per-line corpora (mixed legal/illegal, leading-zero/out-of-range stress, surrounding-alphanumeric-and-whitespace corpus incl. empty lines) plus four distinct Jupyter port scenarios (explicit ports, unset, non-integer fallback). quantitative_correctness=2: every label and every bind/200 result must match the independent ground truth exactly. interaction_statefulness=1: the verifier must start/stop long-lived Jupyter server processes and poll bind readiness. resource_pressure=0 (small collection, stdlib/gawk only).
